description: Restyle the colours only. Keep the exact same silhouette, the same pose, the same branch layout and every leaf and root exactly where it is. Take the palette, the soft cream-and-brown outline, the flat facet shading and the gentle low contrast from the reference plate: turn the near-black outline into a warm mid brown, mute the greens toward a soft sage olive, warm and desaturate the bark, and flatten the glossy highlights into flat blocks of colour. It must still read as a green leafy tree on a fully transparent background.
